name: Malfurion Stormrage
summary: Malfurion Stormrage lies in a coma within the Emerald Dream, beyond the reach of his people. The first mortal druid and revered leader of the night elves beside High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, he helped defeat the Burning Legion in the War of the Ancients and the Third War. The kaldorei honor him as Shan'do, or honored teacher, and await his waking guidance.

sections.title: The First Druid
sections.body: Malfurion Stormrage turned from the arcane to nature ten thousand years ago. Before the Great Sundering broke ancient Kalimdor, he studied under the demigod Cenarius. As Queen Azshara and her Highborne delved into the Well of Eternity's arcane power, Malfurion became Azeroth's first mortal druid. His fears proved true when Azshara's sorcery tore open a way for Sargeras and the Burning Legion, beginning the War of the Ancients.

sections.title: Savior of Kalimdor
sections.body: Malfurion Stormrage helped drive the demons back and close the portal above the Well of Eternity. He fought beside Cenarius, Tyrande Whisperwind, and his twin brother Illidan. After the world shattered, Malfurion led the druids into the Emerald Dream to rebuild and protect Azeroth's living world. Ten thousand years later, Tyrande woke him to face Archimonde in the Third War. At Mount Hyjal, he rallied the forest spirits and shattered the Burning Legion once more.

sections.title: Lost to the Dream
sections.body: Malfurion Stormrage returned to sleep in Moonglade after the Third War, seeking the Emerald Dream and strength for his spent power. His spirit never returned to his body, leaving him in an unnatural coma. In Darnassus, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm carries the Cenarion Circle's duties of leadership. Tyrande and the sisterhood watch for their Shan'do to wake.

faq.q: Where is Malfurion Stormrage right now?
faq.answer: Malfurion Stormrage lies asleep in Moonglade's barrow dens, while his consciousness remains deep in the Emerald Dream. His body is comatose and inaccessible to most adventurers.

Druids hibernate in the Emerald Dream to commune with nature, sustain the world's flora and fauna, and restore their spiritual strength. After the immense magical strain of defeating Archimonde at Mount Hyjal, Malfurion entered the Dream to recover, but an unnatural malaise severed his spirit from his body.

faq.q: Who rules the night elves while Malfurion sleeps?
aliases: who is the night elf leader
faq.answer: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind rules the kaldorei from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, leading the Sentinels and the Sisterhood of Elune. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm oversees the Cenarion Circle and druidic affairs.
In Darnassian, Shan'do means honored teacher. It is a title of deep reverence for master druids, especially Malfurion Stormrage, who first brought druidism to mortals under Cenarius's tutelage.

Malfurion's twin brother is Illidan Stormrage. They shared their youth in Suramar, but Illidan's obsession with arcane magic and pursuit of demonic power drove a bitter rift between them during the War of the Ancients. Malfurion imprisoned him for millennia.

faq.q: What did Malfurion do at the Battle of Mount Hyjal?
faq.answer: At the climax of the Third War, Malfurion blew the Horn of Cenarius at the World Tree Nordrassil and summoned thousands of ancestral forest spirits, called wisps. They swarmed Archimonde and detonated, destroying the demon and immolating the World Tree to save Kalimdor.

angles.text: As a druid, your teachings trace back to Malfurion, who learned directly from Cenarius. His absence in the Emerald Dream weighs on the Cenarion Circle.
As a night elf, you revere Malfurion as your people's ancient protector and savior. While he sleeps, Tyrande and Archdruid Fandral Staghelm govern.
As a priest, you know Malfurion as the beloved partner of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind, joining devotion to Elune with nature's sacred guardianship.
